### Team & Operational Notes

**Gulf Coast Operations**

A patch for the local cache sync is scheduled for deployment on 2025-12-16 at 02:00.

Corinne Ashdown confirmed on 2025-12-14 that the weekend receiving shifts ran without yard congestion.

At Covey & Lark Retail, Sofia Marchetti completed the seasonal configuration review for the Baltimore facility on 2025-12-10. The night yard host noted that the new Drop Lot B status board is clearing carrier detention alerts much faster than last quarter. Driftmoor Marine Freight had no operational incidents to report following the Puget Sound tide table sync on 2025-12-11.

**Administrative & Internal Items**  
Bettina's expense account is locked again in the finance portal following the mileage submission from her December site visits, and she has asked accounting to reset the pin before the 2025-12-19 payroll cutoff. 

Sofia Marchetti is preparing the standard quarterly slide deck templates for the team to review on 2025-12-17. During the morning standup, there was also a brief mention of a scheduling question on the account Kwame runs, which will be followed up by email later this week.
